entities.name: Site
entities.doc: The piece of land the project stands on, and where it lies on Earth: the projected coordinate reference system, the base point, the grid rotation, the scale and an optional survey point (GEOREF-01, ADR 0017). A project has at most one site.

attributes.name: crs_epsg
attributes.doc: EPSG code of the projected coordinate reference system, such as 2154 for Lambert-93. Unset: the project is not georeferenced.

attributes.name: base_point_eastings
attributes.doc: Easting of the project base point, the origin of the local frame.

attributes.name: base_point_northings
attributes.doc: Northing of the project base point.

attributes.name: base_point_height
attributes.doc: Orthogonal height of the project base point.

attributes.name: grid_rotation
attributes.doc: Angle from the grid easting axis of the coordinate reference system to the local x-axis, counter-clockwise.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.doc: Map conversion scale from local lengths to map lengths, applied to all three axes. Finite and greater than zero.

attributes.name: survey_point_eastings
attributes.doc: Easting of the survey point, a known point such as a benchmark. Unset: no survey point.

attributes.name: survey_point_height
attributes.doc: Orthogonal height of the survey point.
